newsitem.title: JAPAN: SIMEX Brent sleeps through Asian holidays.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent sleeps through Asian holidays.

text.p: SIMEX Brent futures remained unchanged on Thursday, with official holidays in 12 Asian countries effectively elimating deal-making as of 0625 GMT.
"There's absolutely nothing happening today because of the holidays," said one Singapore trader.
Singapore and much of the rest of Asia celebrated Labour Day on Thursday.
In late afternoon trade, the June contract was bid/offered at $18.38/$18.48 per barrel, but no deals were done.
SIMEX June Brent settled at $18.52 on Wednesday.
On the IPE, June Brent closed at $18.52 on Wednesday after falling from a short-lived rally in late trade.
On the ACCESS after-hours system, June NYMEX light crude was slightly lower, last trading at $20.12, down 9 cents from the New York close.
